function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year, before any debt information may be disclosed.

account_id.description: The customer's account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or birth year the customer provided.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the payment date and amount the customer has committed to. Only callable after successful verification.

ptp_date.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the customer agreed to pay by.

amount.description: The amount in INR the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer's registered number via SMS or WhatsApp. Only callable after successful verification.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call to a human agent, for hardship requests or disputes. Only callable after successful verification.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called exactly once before every call ends, regardless of outcome.
